hero.subtitle: Front-end developer with a back-end foundation. I build interfaces with React, TypeScript and Tailwind — and I've worked with C#/.NET on APIs and desktop apps, which gives me end-to-end product vision.

sections.projectsSubtitle: A selection of what I've built.
sections.aboutText: I'm Matheus, a front-end developer with a back-end foundation. I enjoy turning problems into simple, fast and accessible interfaces. I work with React, TypeScript and Tailwind, and I've built APIs and desktop apps in C#/.NET — which lets me see the product as a whole, from the database to the screen.

card.role: Front-end developer with a back-end foundation
card.bio: React, TypeScript and Tailwind on the front. C#/.NET on the back. Interfaces that connect people to products.

projects.maevor: Catalog and quote website for a 3D printing studio. Complete flow: the client describes the idea, receives modeling, and approves on the site.
projects.animadesk: Veterinary management SaaS: patients, tutors, medical records, vaccines and team. Multi-tenancy with RLS on Supabase — each clinic only sees its own data.
projects.aurum: Web/mobile financial management app with an AI agent. Full-stack in C#/.NET + SQL Server, with per-user ownership, shared Walletspaces and Docker Compose.
projects.githubcards: Custom cards with GitHub profile data — avatar, stats, technologies and featured projects.
